steps.input:
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
# fill block (13,28) is 6x2: what's in O there and does it match a transformed window with some cells 6 allowed?
for cc in ccs6(I.tolist()):
    rs=[p[0] for p in cc]; cs=[p[1] for p in cc]
    r0=min(rs);c0=min(cs);r1=max(rs);c1=max(cs)
    hh=r1-r0+1;ww=c1-c0+1
    tpat=O[r0:r0+hh,c0:c0+ww]
    hits=[]
    # try all dihedral transforms of the INPUT (source 6s allowed but must not be 6 at source? no—source can't contain 6 anyway since src has no 6)
    for nm in TF:
        tr=D[nm](I)
        th,tw=tr.shape
        for i in range(th-hh+1):
            for j in range(tw-ww+1):
                s=tr[i:i+hh,j:j+ww]
                if (s!=6).all() and np.array_equal(s,tpat): hits.append((nm,i,j))
    print('comp',(r0,c0,hh,ww),'hits',hits[:4])
